columns.name: num_attendence_of_students
columns.description: The number of attendance of the students from the Student_Club that the event has, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_cost
columns.description: The percentage of cost for the event based on the total cost for all events.

columns.name: amount_spent_on_advertisement
columns.description: The amount spent on advertisement for the event, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: amount_budgeted
columns.description: The amount budgeted for the event, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_budget_for_parking
columns.description: The percentage of the budget for parking.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name of the member. Concatenate the first name and last name with a space separating them.

columns.name: position
columns.description: Position of the member in the club.

columns.name: incurred_expenses_in_more_than_one_event
columns.description: set to 1 if the member incurred expenses in more than one event, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: has_expense_more_than_avg_expense
columns.description: Set to 1 if the member has any single expense greater than the average expense across all expenses, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: comes_from_the_Art_and_Design_Department
columns.description: Set to 1 if the member comes from the Art and Design Department, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: num_events_attended_2019
columns.description: The number of events the member attended in 2019, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: is_able_to_generate_income_over_40
columns.description: Set to 1 if the member is able to generate income more than $40, otherwise, set to 0
